papers.title: You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection
papers.authors: Joseph Redmon, Santosh Divvala, Ross Girshick, Ali Farhadi
papers.affiliations: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI, Facebook AI Research
papers.intro: YOLO将目标检测重新定义为回归问题，使用单一卷积网络直接预测整张图像中所有物体的边界框和类别概率，实现了实时且统一的检测。

papers.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.authors: Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever, Geoffrey E. Hinton
papers.intro: 本文训练了一个包含5个卷积层和3个全连接层的深度卷积神经网络（AlexNet），在ImageNet上以远优于先前最佳方法的top-5错误率（15.3%）赢得了ILSVRC-2012竞赛，并引入了ReLU、GPU并行、局部响应归一化、重叠池化和Dropout等关键技术。
